item.title: Fuel Shortages Leaving Cuban Drivers Waiting Months to Refuel
item.description: Drivers in Cuba are facing the prospects of waiting several months to refuel their cars, as fuel shortages caused by a U.S. oil siege intensify. To avoid chaos outside gas stations, Cuba’s government last week made it obligatory for drivers to use an app known as Ticket to get refueling appointments. item.title: Sheriff Clears Nancy Guthrie’s Family as Suspects in Disappearance
item.description: Pima County Sheriff Chris Nanos has officially cleared Nancy Guthrie’s entire family, including all siblings and their spouses, as possible suspects in her disappearance.
